name: Floww Music
description:
Now playing with Apple Music–style synced lyrics for Spotify and other MPRIS players: a desktop widget, an adaptive top bar pill, full screen lyrics that can keep the screen on, and a lock screen card that expands into immersive lyrics.

Lyrics come from LRCLIB. An optional, off-by-default Spotify lyrics fallback uses an sp_dc cookie that you paste in yourself; it is stored in the GNOME keyring and only sent to spotify.com.

The unlock-dialog session mode is used to show the player and its controls on the lock screen. It never takes keyboard focus, so typing still goes straight to the password prompt.
